headline: Weathered Expanse Flares as Nevish Line Cools Overnight
war_summary: The wire brings a shift since last edition, with the Weathered Expanse now carrying the running fight at six changes in two hours and fifty in the day around Crow's Nest and Shattered Advance, standing six Warden, one Colonial and two neutral after 6,958 Colonial and 6,805 Warden casualties in the day, though hourly loss rates have cooled sharply, while the Nevish Line has gone quiet in the last two hours after twenty-four in six hours and sixty-nine in the day around Blackcoat Way, Princefal and Grief Mother, holding six Warden and two Colonial. Linn Mercy shows no turn in two hours after thirteen in the day at Lathair, yet reports 3,670 and 5,379 casualties with both rates accelerating in the last hour, and Kuura Strand likewise still at five Colonial and one neutral with no turn in two hours after twenty-two in the day at Faden Point and Talven. Marban Hollow rests at four Warden, three Colonial and one neutral after fifteen changes in the day at Checkpoint Bua, and Godcrofts holds nine Colonial after six, with Callahan's Passage and the Dead Lands spending heavily in casualties without a recorded flip.
